title: FAA AC 120-51E Crew Resource Management Training as crew-coordination guidance rail
summary: FAA AC 120-51E is encoded as a crew-resource-management training guidance rail: it represents formalized guidance for developing and assessing CRM training, not proof that any given airline training program was effective.

status_history.note: Added as rev0027 aviation human-factors/correction rail.

place.scope: aviation safety correction and human-factors infrastructure

claims.claim: FAA’s document-information page identifies AC 120-51E as Crew Resource Management Training, active, issued January 22, 2004, providing guidance for Advanced Qualification Program operators under SFAR 58 and cancelling AC 120-51D.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The cube treats AC 120-51E as a CRM guidance rail and not as evidence that CRM training implementation, assessment, or efficacy was uniform across carriers or incidents.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: guidance document for operators designing, implementing, reinforcing, or assessing CRM training under qualifying FAA training frameworks
limitations: does not by itself measure training quality or accident prevention
revision history and current supersession status need periodic review

handling_notes: Infrastructure records are correction-memory surfaces, not guarantees that recommendations or training actually changed practice.
